en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Al-Mugheira, from Abu Jareer Al-Qummy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It was so that Abu Ja’farasws had fulfilled twenty Witr (Salāts) in one night’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn al-Mughirah from abu Jarir al-Qummiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Abu Ja‘far would perform the Qada’ (compensatory prayer) twenty al-Witr in one night.’”
